note: Known-answer gate corpus for College Football Comparator: famous coach and team numbers (FBS head coaches and programs, any era) with the publisher's exact value, the window and N they used, and a scope saying which games counted (bowls, interim/acting games, vacated games, non-FBS tenures). A row gets in only when every receipt quote string-matches a saved copy of its page (scripts/check-receipts.mjs --pages research/factoids-coaches-teams/pages). The build recomputes each row from the game spine at the row's window, N and scope and fails if it disagrees; where two publishers disagree both numbers are recorded and the site words the difference in Method rather than patching data. Precedence: NCAA record book > ESPN/AP > school > Wikipedia > Sports-Reference.

rows.scope: vs major-college opponent; NCAA FBS era (1937-)
rows.claim: Houston's 100-6 win over Tulsa (23 Nov 1968) is the most points against a major-college opponent in the NCAA record book.

rows.claim: Ohio State's official 2010 record is 0-1 after its 12 wins were vacated.
rows.definition_note: Vacated wins become no-decisions, not losses; the loss stands. Jim Tressel's official total drops 12.

rows.notes: Gate for the vacated-games scope toggle. Tressel's Youngstown State (FCS) years are also in his NCAA milestone line (200th win in 273 games).
